landing.title: Meet the CARIMO routine made for <highlight>your skin</highlight>
landing.subtitle: Take a photo, answer a few questions and discover a personalized, immediately shoppable beauty routine.

consent.title: Your privacy comes first
consent.subtitle: Before opening the camera, please review how this beauty analysis works.
consent.temporary: I agree to the temporary processing of my photo for a cosmetic beauty analysis.
consent.nonDiagnostic: I understand that this experience does not provide a medical diagnosis or prescription.
consent.recommendations: I agree to receive cosmetic product recommendations based on my answers.
consent.privacyText: The demo removes image metadata, does not perform facial recognition and does not use your photo to train a model.

capture.title: Take a clear, natural photo
capture.subtitle: A good photo helps us personalize the cosmetic guidance. You can also continue with the questionnaire only.
capture.tip: Face the camera in natural or white light, without a beauty filter.

questions.medicalNotice: For a diagnosed condition, speak with a qualified healthcare professional before introducing new products.

analysis.title: Creating your CARIMO match
analysis.subtitle: We are combining your beauty goals, environment and preferences.

results.summary: Your routine prioritizes {concern}, while considering your {climate} environment and daily comfort.
results.photoAndAnswers: Personalized from your photo and answers
results.reason: Selected to support {concern} and fit a {climate} lifestyle.

trust.privateText: The demo is designed around temporary photo processing and data minimization.
trust.guidanceText: Results describe beauty concerns and never claim to diagnose a skin condition.
trust.personalText: Every product is linked to the goal, environment and preference that supported its selection.
